preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: grid is a list of lists representing a 2D matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell == 0 or cell == 1 for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Every cell in the grid is either 0 (sea) or 1 (land).

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(grid) <= 500 and all(1 <= len(row) <= 500 for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The dimensions n and m of the grid are between 1 and 500 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] == 1 and not any(grid[rr][cc] == 1 and (rr == 0 or rr == len(grid)-1 or cc == 0 or cc == len(grid[0])-1) for rr in range(len(grid)) for cc in range(len(grid[0])) if (rr, cc) in [(r, c)] + [(rr2, cc2) for rr2 in [rr-1, rr+1] for cc2 in [cc-1, cc+1] if 0 <= rr2 < len(grid) and 0 <= cc2 < len(grid[0]) and grid[rr2][cc2] == 1] for rr in range(len(grid)) for cc in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[rr][cc] == 1 and (rr == 0 or rr == len(grid)-1 or cc == 0 or cc == len(grid[0])-1) and (rr, cc) in [(r, c)] + [(rr2, cc2) for rr2 in [rr-1, rr+1] for cc2 in [cc-1, cc+1] if 0 <= rr2 < len(grid) and 0 <= cc2 < len(grid[0]) and grid[rr2][cc2] == 1]))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of land cells that cannot reach any boundary land cell via a path of adjacent land cells.
